subtasks.title: OrgLivePositionsQuery — latest sc_positions point per kit for an org
subtasks.approach: New ClickhouseQuery. Resolve org's kit_mappings from Kit::getKits(org_id). Query clarity.sc_positions: WHERE lower(kit_mapping) IN (lowercased mappings) AND timestamp_utc >= 24h cutoff, latest row per mapping via argMax(...)/GROUP BY lower(kit_mapping). Select tupleElement(geo,1) lng, tupleElement(geo,2) lat, max timestamp, speed, heading. Map kit_mapping -> kit_id/name/vehicle_type for the response. Mirror kitPosition() semantics (heading only when speed>1).
subtasks.intended_diffs: New query class + test pinning latest-per-mapping, lower() match, geo decode, 24h cutoff, org-mapping enumeration.

subtasks.title: OrgLivePaths — per-kit live trails since cursor (org-wide)
subtasks.approach: New OrgLivePathsQuery (or multi-mapping param on KitHistoricPositionsQuery). Accept org's mappings (or selected subset) + since cursor; return per-kit decimated point arrays; reuse HistoricPathBuilder for segmentation. Keep 3s decimation; cap points per kit.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New query class + test for multi-mapping trails + cursor semantics.

subtasks.title: Admin Bird's-Eye API: controller + routes + org-wide stats + gating
subtasks.approach: New ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController with drivers(), livePositions() (t1), livePaths() (t2), scanPaths()/hits()/heatmapHits()/heatmapOrders() (reuse org-wide queries with org_id + optional kit_ids), stats() (org-wide aggregation in THIS controller via the existing Clickhouse Scan/Hit query builders dropping the kit_id filter — do NOT edit the driver ClarityScoutDashboardController). Register web routes ABOVE scout/{any?} (web.php:110) in the clarity_scout block: GET scout/birds-eye (SPA shell) + scout/birds-eye/api/* data endpoints, gated web+auth + Feature::active(CLARITY_SCOUT) && hasRole(ADMIN), all scoped to auth()->user()->org_id. Access + org-scope feature tests.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New controller; route block above catch-all; gating + org-scope tests.

subtasks.title: Filament 'Scout' nav entry for Bird's Eye
subtasks.approach: Thin Filament Page (or panel NavigationItem) in the 'Scout' group; canAccess = Feature::active(CLARITY_SCOUT) && hasRole(ADMIN); navigation URL → the SPA route (route('clarity-scout.birds-eye') or url). Match ScoutUsersResource/ManageZones registration.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New nav Page linking to the SPA route with the Scout+admin gate.

subtasks.title: Bird's-Eye SPA shell: blade + Vite entry
subtasks.approach: New resources/views/clarity-scout-birds-eye.blade.php (parallel to clarity-scout.blade.php) injecting __CLARITY_SCOUT_CONFIG__ + a birdsEye/admin flag + API base; new resources/js/clarity-scout/birdseye.js mounting the Bird's-Eye app (Pinia + router, NO driver auth store; axios withCredentials). Register birdseye.js in vite.config.js.

subtasks.title: BirdsEyeHome orchestration + org-wide store + DriverSelector
subtasks.approach: New views/BirdsEyeHome.vue reusing MapShell/MapStatsBar/ScoutControlsWidget/DateRangeControl + DashboardOverlay toggles; org-wide fetches via the admin endpoints. Add per-kit collection state for positions/trails (dedicated birdsEye store or parameterized map/dashboard stores). New components/DriverSelector.vue (multi-select, default all) re-scoping kit_ids/mappings across layers + stats.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New orchestration view + selector + store (prefer a new birdsEye store over editing shared map.js/dashboard.js to limit blast radius).

subtasks.title: ScannerMap multi-driver rendering (N markers + N trails)
subtasks.approach: Generalize ScannerMap.vue from a single kit marker + single liveTrail to N per-driver markers + N trails, keyed by kit with per-driver color/label (reuse KitScanPathsQuery color ramp). Drive from the birdsEye store collections; gate by selected drivers. Keep existing single-kit driver behavior intact (guard new paths behind a birdsEye mode prop/flag).
subtasks.intended_diffs: Per-driver marker/trail layers behind a birds-eye mode flag; no behavior change for the driver SPA.
